response.what_it_is: Locally fabricated stainless steel water treatment filter cylinders with PVC manifold piping
hidden_risks: Integrity of internal welds and maximum pressure tolerance
Condition and presence of internal filter media (e.g. sand, activated carbon)
Potential leakage at threaded PVC pipe joints and valve connections
Actual operational status and whether it has been pressure tested
response.failure_mode: AI might confuse the stainless steel vertical cylinders with industrial gas tanks or boilers instead of water treatment filter vessels.
